description: Low-frequency oscillator that runs a second copy of its wave at an adjustable phase offset and crossfades between the two, so the peaks land unevenly

params.text: Sets the rate, doubling per unit of travel from 0.125Hz at the bottom to 128Hz at the top
Sets how far ahead of the first the second copy of the wave runs, 180 degrees at the bottom of its travel down to 90 degrees at the top
Morphs the SAW output from a falling ramp through a triangle to a rising sawtooth, and at the same time widens the PULSE output from 1% to 30% of the cycle
Crossfades between the two copies of the wave, the first alone at the bottom of its travel and the offset one alone at the top
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the frequency jack, -1 to +1, before it is added to the FREQ knob
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the swing jack, -1 to +1, before it is added to the SWING knob
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the shape jack, -1 to +1, before it is added to the SHAPE knob
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the mix jack, -1 to +1, before it is added to the MIX knob

inputs.text: Added to the FREQ knob through the trimmer beside it, one volt per doubling of the rate
Added to the SWING knob through the trimmer beside it, 10V shifting the offset across its whole 90 degree span; the total is held between the two ends of the knob's travel
Added to the SHAPE knob through the trimmer beside it, 10V covering the knob's whole travel; the total is held between the two ends of it
A rising edge through 2V restarts the first wave at the beginning of its cycle and puts the second wave at its offset
Added to the MIX knob through the trimmer beside it, 10V covering the knob's whole travel; the total is held between the two ends of it

outputs.text: The morphed wave, 0V to 10V, mixed from both copies
The pulse, 10V while the pulse is high and 0V otherwise, mixed from both copies
